name: Agent activity
responsibility: Publishes complete canonical subject-claim and durable action snapshots with explicit vault identity to every pane; private to the workbench
description: Consumes the public model feed for the vaults a connected pane can show: the registry's readable vaults, each pane's own vault and every vault a write named. Multiple subject claims may coexist. Only a durable operation receipt supplies writer and doing attribution. After the last claim ends, a durable action lingers briefly and then the tracker sends an empty snapshot. Moved from the server into the workbench, which disposes it before the voice agent's shutdown (TASK-653.09).

outgoing.label: send each vault's snapshot to every pane
watch the vaults a connected pane can show
